access_token_created.description:
An administrator created an access token (ADR 0210). The event never carries the
token.

access_token_revoked.description:
An access token was revoked, or it ended with the access of its creator. A token
that reaches its expiry has no event.

access_tokens_of_creator_revoked.description:
Every access token of an account ended, because the account was banned, removed or
recovered.

account_departure_changed.description:
An account became inactive, was deleted, or returned (`departure` absent) (ADR 0121).
Every active account receives it.

account_profile_updated.description: The name or the avatar of an account that the recipient may see has changed.

account_recovered.description: The server owner gave a new device access to the account of the recipient.

call_access_ended.description:
The account of the recipient lost the access to a voice channel, or can no longer
reach the other account of a direct message, while something of it waited there: an
invitation that it got or made, a request to enter, a move, or a direct-message call.
Those have ended, and no outcome of them follows. The event names nothing: the client
discards what it holds for the places that it can no longer see.

call_ended.description:
Nobody is in the call any more. Its lock, its blocks, its requests and its
invitations have ended with it.

call_entry_answered.description:
The request of the recipient to enter a voice channel has ended. The event names the
request and nothing of the channel, so it also reaches an account that can no longer
see the channel.

call_entry_requested.description: A person outside asks to enter a locked or full voice channel. Anyone inside answers.

call_entry_resolved.description: A request to enter has ended. This event goes to the people inside the call.

oneOf.description: The person inside who answered.

call_invitation_resolved.description:
An invitation that the recipient got or made has ended. The event names the
invitation and nothing of the call.

call_invited.description:
The recipient is invited into a call, or the other participant of a direct message
calls. An account that cannot see the voice channel any more does not receive it.

oneOf.description: Absent: the voice channel is not locked.

call_meeting_ended.description:
Meeting mode is off. Every microphone block in the call is removed, the ones that a
moderator set included.

call_meeting_started.description:
Meeting mode is on. Every participant except the presenter who had no microphone block
has one now, with the reason `meeting`.

call_move_requested.description:
A moderator moves the recipient into another voice channel. The device in the call
asks for the join of the destination and joins it. An account that cannot see both
voice channels does not receive it.

call_move_resolved.description:
A move of the recipient, or one that the recipient asked for, has ended. The event
names the move and nothing of the two channels.

call_participant_joined.description: The media server lists a person whom the server allows in the call.

call_participant_updated.description:
The own settings, the blocks, the raised hand or the screen share of a person in a
call changed. The event carries the whole participant.

call_speaking.description:
The people in a voice channel who speak now, as the clients inside report it. The
list replaces the one before. It is not sent for a channel that hides who is inside.

call_started.description:
The first person is in the room of a call: the voice channel is in use, or the
direct-message call has begun.

category_deleted.description: A category was deleted. Its channels stay and have no category.

channel_archived.description:
A channel was archived (ADR 0410). It is read-only and leaves the channel list; the
call of a voice channel ends.

channel_deletion_due.description: The notice that the server deletes an archived channel in 7 days, at `deletes_at`.

channel_override_set.description:
The allow set and the deny set of one role in a channel. Two empty sets mean that the
role has no override in the channel.

channel_restored.description: An archived channel is a channel of the list again.

device_added.description: A device was added to the account of the recipient.

device_removed.description: A device of the account was removed. Its sessions have ended.

direct_mute_removed.description: The account of the recipient turned the mute of a direct-message conversation off.

direct_mute_set.description:
The account of the recipient muted its direct-message conversation with another
account, or changed the end of the mute.

export_removed.description: An export of the recipient was removed with its file.

export_updated.description: The state of an export of the recipient changed (ADR 0411).

glossary_replaced.description: The glossary of a workspace was replaced. The terms are read from its route.

invite_changed.description: The workspaces granted by an existing invite were narrowed.

invites_of_creator_revoked.description: Every invite that the account created and that was not revoked is revoked now.

notification_default_changed.description:
The notification default of a workspace was set, changed or removed. `level` is
absent when the workspace has none now.

notifications_read.description: Every visible notice created at or before `until` is read at `read_at` (ADR 0412).

own_call_changed.description:
The call that the account of the recipient is in has changed. An event that names a
voice channel reaches the account only while it can see that channel; the event of a
leave names no place.

oneOf.description: Absent: the account is in no call.
Present when the account left a call: why.

permissions_changed.description:
What the recipient may see or do has changed: in one workspace, or on the server when
no workspace is named. The client loads a snapshot.

recording_removed.description: A recording was removed with its files and its transcript.

recording_started.description:
A recording of the call of a voice channel was asked for. The event carries the
recording without its segments.

recording_updated.description:
The state of a recording changed, a stop was asked for, or a segment was added or
failed. The event carries the whole recording without its segments; the segments
are read from the route of the recording.

server_role_deleted.description: A server role was deleted. No account holds it.

server_role_positions_shifted.description: Replaces the positions of existing server roles before the following creation.

thread_follow_changed.description:
The account of the recipient chose to follow a thread or not, or removed its choice.
`following` is what holds now; `follow_setting` is the choice, absent when none is
set (ADR 0412).

transcript_line_corrected.description:
A person corrected the line at the position `line` of the transcript of a
recording. The event carries no text, no author and no time, because the log of
events keeps an event after its recording was removed (ADR 0607). The line is read
from the route of the lines.

transcript_speaker_renamed.description:
A person gave a name to the voice with the label `Speaker <speaker>` in the shared
sound of a recording. The event carries no name, for the same reason. The label is
read from the route of the transcript.

workspace_deleted.description:
A workspace was deleted with everything that it held. The event goes to the accounts
that were members of it and to the administrators.

workspace_role_deleted.description:
A workspace role was deleted. No member holds it, and no channel has an override
of it.

workspace_role_positions_shifted.description: Replaces the positions of existing non-everyone roles before creation.

AccessTokenInfo.description: An access token as a list shows it. It never contains the token.

created_by.description:
The account that created the token. A request with the token is decided with the
permissions that this account has at the time of the request.

AccountProfile.description: What an account shows of itself to the accounts that may see it.

oneOf.description: Present when the account is inactive or deleted. Such a profile has no avatar.

AccountStatus.description:
The state of an account (ADR 0113, ADR 0121).

A server can add states within one API version (ADR 0209). A state that this build does
not know is read as [`AccountStatus::Unknown`]. `Unknown` is never written.

AccountSummary.description: An account as a moderator sees it.

ArchivedChannel.description: A channel that is archived: it is read-only and is in no channel list (ADR 0410).

deletes_at.description:
The server does not delete the channel before this time. Absent: the server does not
delete it, because the workspace has no archive period or the channel contains
permanent messages.

Avatar.description:
The stored avatar of an account. The image itself is read from
`GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/avatar`.

hash.description:
The SHA-256 hash of the image in lower-case hexadecimal. It changes when the image
changes, so a client keeps the image for as long as it sees the same hash.

CallInvitation.description:
An invitation into a call: from a person inside a voice channel, or the ringing of a
direct-message call.

CallMove.description:
A move of a person from one voice channel to another. The person's device joins the
destination first; the server takes the person out of the source when it has seen that
join (ADR 0511).

CallParticipant.description:
One person in a call. A block and the person's own setting are separate: removing a block
returns the microphone or the sound to `muted` or `deafened`.

oneOf.description: Metadata of the avatar, without its image bytes.

deafened.description: The person's own sound setting, as their client reports it.

identity.description: The identity of the person's participant in the room of the media server.

muted.description: The person's own microphone setting, as their client reports it.

oneOf.description: The direct message of two accounts. `low_account_id` is the smaller identifier.

hides_occupants.description: True when a voice channel shows who is inside only to the people inside (ADR 0504).

permanent_messages.description: The channel setting that makes each message sent under it permanent.

user_limit.description:
The largest number of people in the call of a voice channel. Absent: no limit. A
person who is invited or moved in can pass it (ADR 0504).

oneOf.description:
Starts or restarts the delivery after `cursor` at `level`. Without a cursor the
delivery starts after the newest event.

Cursor.description:
A place in the order of the events of one server. An event with a position at or below the
position of a cursor is covered by the state that the cursor belongs to.

Departure.description:
Why an account is no longer on the server, as its profile states it to other accounts
(ADR 0121). A ban and a removal are not stated.

DeviceOrigin.description: How a device key came to belong to its account.

DirectMute.description:
A muted direct-message conversation: the account that muted it gets no call invitation
from the other account (ADR 0515).

account_id.description: The other account of the conversation.

until.description: The time at which the mute ends. Absent: it lasts until it is turned off.

EndReason.description: Why the server ended the access of a connection.

EntryRequest.description: A request of a person outside to enter a locked or full voice channel.

One change of the state of a server. New events are added; the fields of an existing event
are not changed or removed within one API version (ADR 0206).

Export.description: One export. It belongs to the account that asked for it; no other account reads it.

bytes.description: The size of the file. Present with the state `ready`.

expires_at.description: When the server removes the export. Present when the export has finished.

oneOf.description: Present with the state `failed`.

id.description:
The export holds the items of its place whose identifier is not greater than this
one: what existed when the export was asked for.

ExportFailure.description: Why an export has no file.

ExportRemoval.description: Why the server removed an export.

ImageType.description: The formats in which the server stores an avatar.

created_by_name.description: Current creator name in a list; the name at creation in an event.

oneOf.description:
The inactive account to which the key of the request belongs. An approval makes that
account active again with its own name, not the name of the request (ADR 0121).

LeaveReason.description: Why a person is no longer in a call.

Meeting.description: Meeting mode: every microphone except the presenter's is blocked (ADR 0505).

MicrophoneBlock.description: A block of a person's microphone. The server enforces it: the person cannot send audio.

OwnCall.description: The call that the account is in, and the device that it is in the call with.

hides_occupants.description: The retained hide setting, or unknown when an older server omitted it.

Recording.description: A recording without its segments. Events and lists carry this form.

bytes.description: The bytes of the files of the recording. Absent until the files are processed.

ended_at.description: When the last job of the recorder had ended. Absent while the recording is active.

failed_segments.description: The number of segments that failed. The segments state what was saved of each.

oneOf.description: Present with the state `failed`.

language.description:
`auto`, or the language code that the person who started the recording set for the
transcript (ADR 0603).

recording_since.description: When the first job of the recorder was started. Absent before.

requested_at.description: When the recording was asked for.

segments.description: The number of segments of the recording.

oneOf.description: Present from the moment a stop is asked for.

timeline_started_at.description:
The first sample of the earliest file of the recording. The times of the transcript
count from it. Absent until the files are processed, and without a file.

transcript_lines.description: The number of lines of the transcript.

RecordingFailure.description:
Why nothing of a recording was saved. Read with an unknown value as
[`RecordingStopReason`] is.

RecordingState.description:
The state of a recording. The states follow each other in this order; the last three are
final.

oneOf.description: The person who stopped the recording. Absent when the server stopped it.

RecordingStopReason.description:
Why a recording was stopped. A server can add reasons within one API version; a reason
that this build does not know is read as [`RecordingStopReason::Unknown`], which is never
written (ADR 0209).

RecoveryNotice.description:
One recovery of an account, as the account sees it. A device keeps the notice of a
recovery until it acknowledges it (ADR 0112).

oneOf.description: Absent when the recovery was done with the host command.
The first message of every connection.

heartbeat_seconds.description:
The server sends a ping at this interval and expects a frame from the client within
`idle_seconds`.

oneOf.description: The answer to a `subscribe`. Events after `cursor` follow.

id.description:
The position of the event. It grows from one event to the next; an event with an
`id` at or below the last one that the client has applied is a repeat.

oneOf.description: The connection has received every event up to `cursor` that it may receive.

The server does not continue from the cursor of the client: as the answer to a
`subscribe`, or as the end of a subscription. The connection stays open and delivers
nothing. Whatever the reason, the client discards every collection of this server
that it holds, loads a snapshot and subscribes with the cursor of the snapshot. That
includes the collections that the snapshot does not carry, such as members, accounts,
devices, invites, join requests, server roles and channel overrides: the client loads
them again from their routes when it needs them.
The last message before the server closes a connection whose session no longer counts.
Present with the reason `recovered`.

ServerPermission.description: A permission that acts on the whole server. The number is the bit of the stored set.

ShareAudio.description: The sound that a screen share sends (ADR 0502).

SoundBlock.description: A block of a person's sound. The client of the person applies it (ADR 0503).

StreamEpoch.description: Identifies one history of event positions. It changes when positions start again.

TokenAction.description:
One group of routes that an access token can reach. A token states its actions when it is
created, and a request with it is refused on a route of another action.

A server can add actions within one API version. An action that this build does not know
is read as [`TokenAction::Unknown`], which is never written.

TranscriptState.description: The state of the transcript of a recording.

is_default.description: True for the workspace that an invite or an approval grants when it names none.

oneOf.description: Metadata of the avatar, without its image bytes.

WorkspacePermission.description: A permission inside one workspace. The number is the bit of the stored set.

is_everyone.description: True for the role that every member of the workspace holds. It is never assigned.
